before_times: who is dancing: the parent's own child, or the adult themselves
for a child: the age (it sets the age group) and the style (ballet, tap, jazz, hip-hop)
danced before? which style, and for how long (it sets the level; a trained dancer is placed by Sam)
for a private or wedding lesson: the goal, and at the studio or at home
for a class at a host's place: how many dancers, their ages, and the place
after_time: does the dancer have the shoes the class needs? (socks are fine for a trial)
anything the teacher should know, like a first class or feeling shy
for a home lesson: the address, the room, and a clear space about 10 by 10 feet
secure_page_only: the parent or guardian's yes that they may book for the child, and the waiver signed for the child
the child's first name and age, any health notes or allergies, and an emergency contact
the pick-up list: the adults who may take the child home
a yes or no for photos or video of the child in class
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian for anyone under 18, who books, signs and gets every text; a teen gets a link to send to a parent

stop.words: someone hurt or unwell right now: a hard fall, a head injury, an ankle they can't stand on, fainting, chest pain, trouble breathing

go_on.words: an injury that's healing, or a health condition
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the note goes on the secure page for the teacher; Rosie gives no health advice

go_on.words: a child who is shy, nervous or new to dance
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the note goes to the teacher on the secure page, who keeps a trial dancer close

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver and the child's details
steps.when: before the first class, signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18; adults sign their own
steps.goodFor: the season (1 year), or until the studio changes it
steps.result: signed: the booking goes on; not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
steps.when: on the secure page while booking; the parent can change them any time
steps.result: only adults on the list take the child home; no answer to photos counts as no

steps.name: Placement for a trained dancer
steps.when: before booking a class above level 1
steps.result: Sam places the dancer by level; the trial books once he OKs

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: come 10 minutes early to check in; hair back; a leotard or leggings and a T-shirt; socks or bare feet for a trial; a water bottle; for a home lesson, a clear space about 10 by 10 feet and the song you'll dance to

staff.skills: ballet, tap, jazz, hip-hop, contemporary, ballroom and wedding dances; Creative Movement for ages 3 to 5
staff.licenses_or_certificates: no person license for teaching dance unless the state's form names one
staff.supervision: a child is never alone with one adult behind a closed door; two adults in the building for kids' classes (a teacher and the front desk: the studio's setting)
staff.who_oks: Sam places trained dancers and OKs private lessons; Pat may OK them too
staff.ratio: up to 12 dancers per teacher in a kids' class (the studio's setting; a ratio from the state's form wins)

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian for anyone under 18, who books, signs and gets every text; a teen gets a link to send to a parent
children_and_age.minors_texts: a teen under 18 gets a link to send to a parent; Rosie never texts the parent first

visit.check_in: at the studio: the parent gives the child's check-in code at the front desk, or the desk ticks names on the class roster; at a home: the code at the door; at a host's place: the host's contact gives the code
visit.done: the check-in code or the roster tick; for a lesson away from the studio, the code or DONE from the teacher
visit.changes_at_visit: a teacher change is texted to every parent booked; 30 more minutes at a home lesson is priced and OK'd first

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: from the state form: teaching dance usually needs no state license; some places register a dance studio, or set rules for selling classes ahead (a bond, a written contract, a cancel right)
license.who: the business, for any studio registration, bond or account kept apart for money paid ahead
license.ask: any studio or business registration number; where the state's form asks, proof of a bond for a season of classes sold ahead
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it, or where a host (a school, a preschool, a senior center) asks for proof
license.background: a background check for each person who teaches or works with children, where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form; the owner can also turn it on): who ran it and when, kept on file, renewed on the state's schedule

never_in_a_text: a child's last name, age, health notes, allergies, pick-up list or photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name only; texts to Sam or the staff carry no child details at all: they name the parent and the class, and link to the secure page
